subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who conforms to accepted behaviour or established practices
solution: The correct answer is: **Conformist** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **conformist **is a person who willingly **complies with established customs, practices, or societal norms**. (एक व्यक्ति जो स्वेच्छा से स्थापित रीति-रिवाजों, प्रथाओं या सामाजिक मानदंडों का अनुपालन करता है) • Conformists tend to follow traditional or mainstream behaviour and avoid deviating from accepted standards. • **Example**: *She was seen as a conformist because she adhered to the dress code and social norms without questioning or challenging them.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • A **psychologist **is a professional who studies the human mind, behaviour, and mental processes. (**मनोविज्ञानी**) • A **socialist **is an advocate or supporter of socialism, an economic and political system advocating for collective or government ownership and control of the means of production and distribution of wealth. (**समाजवादी**) • **Rebelist **refers to someone who rebels against authority or established norms. (**विद्रोही**) 37:Ta0b, The correct answer is: **Fertile**
